item.content:encoded:
SCP-304 lists a total of 63 persons with the title of "President"

we currently have 45 united states presidents so this suggests that future presidents are listed, or at least it would if there weren't so many other countries with Presidents. vladimir Putin is President of Russia for example. I think the statement should be more specific and say president of the United states, so it conveys the proper implications. Are there any prime ministers or other world leaders in the list.
I like that the list stops and repeats. The meaning is left to the readers interpretation. That could be interpreted in many ways. Maybe global government ceases to exist. Maybe the earth is in a time loop and resets after that point. Maybe the aliens have incomplete information so they don't know anything about events further in the future.

item.content:encoded:
Glad to see my ancient work is still being read. And as always, thanks for the feedback :)

"If the threat feels like an unresolved puzzle it kinda feels irrelevant, like it may be a threat in a few years time but for now isn't worth a second glance."

This is one of the few times I was comfortable leaving the unknowns unknown. The "SCP-ness" of this comes not from the radio signal itself, but the implications thereof.

Is it an always-accurate prediction of who our most powerful leaders will be, or some kind of instruction being issued to unknown parties which then act to fulfill its wishes? Is the source a far away galaxy, or something much closer? Are the final 7 items actually names, or something else? Why does it end and repeat? Why any of it for that matter?

I'm 100% sure that I'd ruin it by trying to answer any of those questions, though a better writer might have pulled it off!

item.content:encoded:
Not really sure what to think of this one. I found a lot of the early connections extremely quickly (the date of invention of the codes). Next deduction is that the final code is beyond us at the minute so we cant find out more. It just feels too fake…. I cant think of a better word to describe it y'know? I always try to imagine these SCP's as an authors attempt to keep me safe from a threat. If the threat feels like an unresolved puzzle it kinda feels irrelevant, like it may be a threat in a few years time but for now isnt worth a second glance.

EDIT: I went back and reread the posting rules and this barely qualifies >.< I've thought about it a little more and I think it needs slightly more information to work on with regard to the last seven names. Possibly some failed translation examples to show what it isnt; eg, researchers attempting to render the sound into an image to see if future encryption uses images as an encryption code. You could even make a report of the use of existing decryption resources and examples of how those resources failed (computers overheating, etc).
And the source of the transmissions needs a little fleshing out in my opinion. Like the distance from earth, possibly the signal source moving when the moon moves by proving it to be originating from a physical object. Possibly a record of earlier transmissions, I understand the Nikola Tesla may, or may not, have received a radio transmission from space. A nice little name drop or a source for a [DATA REDACTED] cliffhanger. People (like me) may check up on the original source and discover the Nikola Tesla claims, could work nicely ^^
Other than that I do like it. It is mysterious enough to have SCP status, but I'd like to see where it came from. Or at least be able to puzzle it out XD

lol, glorious
No, not exactly.
The signal is coming from a very distant point in space. It can be received by any sufficiently powerful radio receiver that happens to listen in. That's not good.

So the containment procedure is to send a space probe in that direction and have the probe transmit a masking signal back to Earth, so no one but the Foundation can access the original signal and anyone who stumbles upon it thinks it's just the probe doing its thing.

item.content:encoded:
It would take a better writer than I to do interviews/logs/reports on something so simple.
This is one of the few SCP ideas I've had where I feel comfortable leaving the unknowns unknown.
Where is it coming from?
Who is sending it?
How long has it been transmitting?
Is it predicting who will be powerful leaders on Earth, or influencing us?
Who are the 7 names in the not-yet-invented format?
Why does it repeat after those 7?
How and how much does it know about O5?
Then of course there's "Why?"

I feel that trying to answer any of those would probably take the piss out of the whole thing.

This is much too short and kind of boring. I imagine containment dialogue went something like this.

"It lists the official leaders of the United States!"

"…and?"

"It lists leaders that haven't happened yet!"

"…and?"

"The list suddenly ends, implying that the US stops existing!"

"…and?"

"Uh, no, that's… that's pretty much it, really."

"So what makes this an SCP and not an anomalous item?"

"Uhhhhhhh… I dunno, come t' think of it. But I've already written the report."

"Oh fine."

It's insubstantial, seen? This concept could work as part of a larger something, but as a standalone piece it's really very meh.
